segments.text: Ok so this is the Multimodal Attachments page for Google Antigravity on React Native, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, umm, the quick start leaves the message list as a comment, so there's nowhere for the answer to show.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
Moving on to the demo. Tapping attach should open a file picker, but nothing opens, and there's a red text error on load.
So basically, you should be able to attach a photo and get an answer, but the picker never opens, and the quick start has no message list anyway.
So yeah, this is the issue, kindly fix it.
